prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='THETA', seasonality_champion='ONLY_FT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: THETA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) but poor seasonality (-0.20), while ONLY_FT_catboost excels at seasonality (0.61) with lowest overall RMSE (172.86). The champions split across components, combined with high model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 6.03) and concept drift detection, strongly favors STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit additive decomposition. Early horizon specialist (ONLY_FT_catboost, RMSE=64.67) differs from late specialist (DWT_catboost, RMSE=204.16), suggesting per-horizon optimization within the stacking framework.
